answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, released only after three unrelated confirmations, rewards vest against future work. The harbor of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A marble of per-task receipts records who did what, and the vertex of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
